name: WdOMathShapeType
description: Specifies the appearance of delimiters (parentheses, braces, brackets) in relationship to the content that they surround.

constants.name: wdOMathShapeCentered
constants.description: Vertically centers delimiters around the entire height of the equation causing delimiters grow equally above and below their midpoint.

constants.name: wdOMathShapeMatch
constants.description: Matches the shape of the delimiters to the size of their contents.
